Task: invoice_extract
Description: Extract the totals of an invoice.
Inputs:
- document: the invoice text
- context
- items: line items
Outputs:
- total: the grand total
- currency
- notes

Instruction:
Read the invoice and return its totals.
Use the stated currency.

Examples:
[
  {
    "inputs": {
      "context": null,
      "document": "Total: 5 EUR",
      "items": []
    },
    "outputs": {
      "currency": "EUR",
      "total": 5
    },
    "rationale": "The total line says 5 EUR."
  },
  {
    "inputs": {
      "context": {
        "z": 1
      },
      "document": "Sum \u003cb\u003e7\u003c/b\u003e \u0026 tax"
    },
    "outputs": {
      "currency": "GBP",
      "notes": "tax \"included\"",
      "total": 7.5
    }
  }
]

Input JSON:
```json
{
  "context": {
    "apple": null,
    "emoji": "price 💶",
    "nested": {
      "deep": [
        {
          "a": [],
          "b": "2"
        },
        [
          [
            "x"
          ]
        ]
      ],
      "raw": {
        "keep": [
          1,
          2
        ]
      }
    },
    "numbers": [
      1e3,
      2.5,
      -7,
      255,
      1e+21,
      1e-7
    ],
    "zebra": true
  },
  "document": "Invoice #42\n\"Quoted\" total: 1,234.50 EUR\tdue 2026-10-24 \u003cscript\u003e",
  "items": [
    {
      "sku": "A-1\u003c2\u003e\u00263",
      "quantity": 3,
      "price": 0.30000000000000004,
      "tags": [
        "x",
        "\u2028line",
        "tab\there"
      ],
      "meta": {
        "Mid": "case",
        "alpha": "first",
        "zeta": "last"
      },
      "supplier": {
        "name": "Größe \u0026 Söhne",
        "country": "DE"
      }
    },
    {
      "sku": "A-1\u003c2\u003e\u00263",
      "quantity": 3,
      "price": 0.30000000000000004,
      "tags": [
        "x",
        "\u2028line",
        "tab\there"
      ],
      "meta": {
        "Mid": "case",
        "alpha": "first",
        "zeta": "last"
      },
      "supplier": {
        "name": "Größe \u0026 Söhne",
        "country": "DE"
      }
    },
    null
  ]
}
```

Return only a JSON object with these output fields: total, currency, notes.

The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "total": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "the grand total"
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "notes": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "total",
    "currency",
    "notes"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
